ServiceOverview.subtitle2Post: — leveraging each strength for the optimal proposal.
ServiceOverview.diagramDesc: We explain the basic staffing relationship that connects companies and staff. We manage recruitment, payroll, and benefits while staff work at your location.

Jobseekers.faq1Q: Is it okay if I've never worked as a temp before?
Jobseekers.faq1A: Yes, absolutely. We provide thorough support for beginners, from explaining job details to follow-up after placement.
Jobseekers.faq2Q: Can I enroll in social insurance?
Jobseekers.faq2A: Yes, those who meet certain conditions can enroll in health insurance, pension, and employment insurance.
Jobseekers.faq3A: No, registration is completely free. Please feel free to contact us.
Jobseekers.faq4A: Yes, if you have a valid residence status, you can register with us. We also offer multilingual support.
Jobseekers.faq5Q: Can I choose my start date?
Jobseekers.faq5A: Yes, you can. Let us know your preferred start date and we will suggest positions that match your schedule.
Jobseekers.faq6A: Yes, we offer a variety of positions ranging from a few days to long-term assignments. Please let us know your preferences.
Jobseekers.faq7A: Yes, transportation allowance may be provided depending on the assignment. Please check with your coordinator for details.
Jobseekers.faq8Q: What should I do if I have problems during my assignment?
Jobseekers.faq8A: Your dedicated coordinator will follow up with you regularly. Feel free to reach out anytime with any concerns or questions.
Jobseekers.faq9A: No, there is no age limit. We welcome workers of all ages and will match you with positions suited to your experience and skills.

You will operate machinery, but the tasks can be learned even without experience, so please apply with confidence.

- Golden Week, summer, and year-end/New Year holidays

Privacy.metaDescription: SANTO CO., LTD.'s privacy policy. Learn how we handle and protect personal information.
Privacy.intro: SANTO Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "the Company") recognizes the protection of personal information as an important responsibility and has established the following Privacy Policy to ensure appropriate handling.
Privacy.section1Body: Personal information refers to information that can identify a specific individual, such as name, address, telephone number, email address, and other descriptions.
Privacy.section2Body: The Company collects personal information through lawful and fair means when you make inquiries, apply for jobs, or use our services.
Privacy.section3Body:
The Company uses collected personal information for the following purposes:
・Provision of staffing and outsourcing services
・Job information guidance and employment support
・Responding to inquiries and communications
・Service improvement and new service development
・Compliance with laws and regulations
Privacy.section4Body:
The Company will not provide personal information to third parties without the individual's consent, except in the following cases:
・When required by law
・When necessary to protect life, body, or property
・When providing necessary information to client companies for employment (with consent)
Privacy.section5Body: The Company implements appropriate security measures to prevent leakage, loss, or damage of personal information. We also provide necessary and appropriate supervision to employees handling personal information.
Privacy.section6Body: When an individual requests disclosure, correction, or deletion of their personal information, we will respond promptly within a reasonable scope.
Privacy.section7Body: Our website may use cookies to improve convenience and for access analysis. If you do not wish to use cookies, you can disable them in your browser settings.
Privacy.section8Body: The Company may change this policy as necessary. Any changes will be published on our website.
Privacy.section9Body: For inquiries regarding the handling of personal information, please contact us at:
